tabs.html:
Lenovo V14 Gen 4 Notebook PC – 13th Gen Intel Core i5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD, 14" FHD, Free DOS, Iron Grey


Upgrade your computing experience with the Lenovo V14 Gen 4 Notebook PC, engineered for productivity, portability, and professional use. Perfect for students, professionals, and business users, this laptop offers high performance and reliability.

Technical Specifications:

Processor: 13th Generation Intel Core i5-13420H (1.30 GHz base, up to 4.60 GHz turbo, 12 MB cache, 4 cores / 8 threads)

Operating System: Free DOS (user can install Windows or Linux)

Memory (RAM): 16 GB DDR4, expandable up to 32 GB

Storage: 512 GB NVMe SSD, high-speed storage for quick boot and file access

Display: 14.0-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) Anti-glare, 250 nits brightness, 45% NTSC

Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics integrated

Audio: Stereo speakers with Dolby Audio, 1.5W x2, dual-array microphones

Ports & Connectivity:

  • 2 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A
  • 1 × USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-C
  • 1 × HDMI 1.4b
  • 1 × RJ-45 Ethernet port
  • 1 × 3.5mm combo audio jack

Networking: Wi-Fi 6 802.11ax, Bluetooth 5.2

Battery: 45Wh, up to 7 hours battery life (varies by usage)

Security Features: TPM 2.0 chip, Kensington lock slot

Weight: Approx. 1.5 kg (portable for travel and office use)

Color: Iron Grey

Build: Sleek, durable chassis with professional design
